AccessibilityStatement.title: Accessibility statement
AccessibilityStatement.intro: Elite Tech Academy wants everyone, including people with disabilities, to be able to learn with us. We work to make this site easy to use for every visitor.
AccessibilityStatement.standard: The site is built to meet Israeli Standard IS 5568, which is based on the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2, level AA.

done.keyboard: Every page and form can be used with a keyboard only, with a clearly visible focus.
done.screenReader: Pages are built with correct headings, labels and landmarks for screen readers.
done.skip: A “Skip to main content” link appears first on every page.
done.contrast: Text colours meet the required contrast, and colour is never the only way information is shown.
done.languages: The site is in Arabic, Hebrew and English, with the correct reading direction for each.
done.errors: Form errors are explained in words and the cursor moves to the first field that needs attention.
done.zoom: The site works when zoomed to 200% and on small phone screens.
done.motion: Animations stop when your device asks for reduced motion.
done.testing: Every page is checked automatically for accessibility problems before each release.

AccessibilityStatement.menu: The “Accessibility settings” button on the side of every page lets you enlarge the text, turn on high contrast, underline links, use an easy-to-read font, stop animations and add space between lines.

limits.captcha: The security check on some forms is provided by Cloudflare and has its own accessibility support.
limits.payment: Payments are made on the payment provider’s secure page, which is not run by us.
limits.videos: Captions for recorded lessons are being added gradually.

AccessibilityStatement.limitsNote: If you have trouble with any part of the site, please tell us and we will help you by another way, for example by phone.
AccessibilityStatement.contact: For questions, problems or requests for accessibility adjustments, contact our accessibility coordinator. We reply within {days} working days.
AccessibilityStatement.updated: This statement was last updated on {date}.
